summary: Mizuho Financial Group filed a Form 6-K announcing an amendment to its existing share repurchase and cancellation program. The Board expanded the repurchase authorization from up to 25 million shares (¥100 billion) to up to 35 million shares (¥200 billion), representing 1.4% of shares outstanding, and extended the repurchase period to September 30, 2026. The cancellation of all repurchased shares is now scheduled for October 23, 2026. This is a routine capital return action under Japanese corporate law, executed via market purchases using the trust method, aligned with a total payout ratio target of 50% or more.
